title: Applications Open: MvPI Internship Programme 2026
bodyHtml:
Step into the field of medical device safety, Materiovigilance and public health surveillance through the Materiovigilance Programme of India (MvPI) Internship Programme.

Gain practical exposure in:

🔹 Materiovigilance & Medical Device Safety
🔹 Medical Device Adverse Event Reporting & Evaluation
🔹 Healthcare Data Analysis, Documentation & Reporting
🔹 Public Health Surveillance & Regulatory Practices
🔹 Research and Professional Skill Development
(opens in a new tab)

Open to students from Pharmacy, Biomedical Sciences/Engineering, Nursing, Public Health, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Clinical Research and Allied Healthcare disciplines.

📍 Apply now: https://forms.gle/XSeo9cnkNWHqCimu8 (opens in a new tab)

Apply now and contribute to India’s mission towards safer healthcare systems and improved patient safety.
